favourite.heading: Why Northwestern can pull away
bullets: Playing at Northwestern is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).

Northwestern is the better football team by 4.0 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 86% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (+4.0 pts).
Conference strength differs and the in-season sample is still thin, worth 2.6 points to Northwestern (+2.6 pts).

underdog.heading: Why Colorado can keep it close
bullets: The outcome range is 15.5 points wide at one sigma — p10 -13.4 to p90 +31.6 for Northwestern, so a projection of +10.6 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 6%.

The market disagrees by 7.1 points. The market is not the truth, but a gap that large is more often the model missing information (a suspension, a starter, a scheme change) than the market being wrong.
